items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: Letter is dated Thursday, 19.11.2026. The period runs 'ab dem Datum dieses Briefes' (from the date of the letter), which is treated as an event marking the start of the period, so under the principle of §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the letter itself is not counted and counting begins the next day, Friday 20.11.2026 (day 1). The letter specifies counting only Monday–Friday ('Gezählt werden Montag bis Freitag'), weekends excluded, and holidays are explicitly excluded from the count ('Feiertage bleiben außer Betracht'); no German public holidays fall in NRW in the relevant window anyway. Counting 12 working days: day1=Fri 20.11, day2=Mon 23.11, day3=Tue 24.11, day4=Wed 25.11, day5=Thu 26.11, day6=Fri 27.11, day7=Mon 30.11, day8=Tue 01.12, day9=Wed 02.12, day10=Thu 03.12, day11=Fri 04.12, day12=Mon 07.12.2026. No weekend/holiday fallback rule is needed since day 12 already lands on a Monday (a working day). Final due date: 07.12.2026.

warnings: The deadline calculation assumes the day of the letter (19.11.2026) is excluded from the 12-working-day count per the usual German-law convention for periods starting 'ab' an event; if the sender instead intends the letter's date itself to count as day 1, the true deadline would be one working day earlier (04.12.2026) — worth confirming with the sender if in doubt.
